text: The author's motive to illuminate the complexities of patriotism and the high cost of war is structurally supported by the narrative focus on characters who must navigate profound moral dilemmas and face the tangible consequences of political decisions. By grounding the political thriller in the author's own experiences as a war correspondent, the text uses these character-driven conflicts to embody the thematic weight of the subject matter, thereby making the abstract concepts of patriotism and war's toll concrete and emotionally resonant for the reader.
